description.value: Established in 2004, 21 Steps Kitchen & Bar is a locally owned and operated second-storey restaurant in the heart of Whistler Village, offering views of the village and surrounding mountains. It serves modern comfort food with generous portions in a warm, casual atmosphere with a full bar. The restaurant has earned recognition for Best Casual Dining and Best Customer Service in Pique News Magazine's 'Best Of Whistler' awards.
